name: NAATTILE SCENE — ഇത് കേരളമാണ്! (Kizhakkumpuram 3D Open World)
description: Explore an authentic Kerala open world with a massive 14-district mega map spanning from Kasaragod in the North down to Thiruvananthapuram in the South, Western Ghats and Arabian Sea, featuring arterial highways, living traffic (Ambassadors, lorries, ambulances, police jeeps, scooters, cycles), village fauna (grazing cows, street dogs, chickens), KSRTC buses, and Babu's auto rickshaw.
